item.title: Show HN: Jev Plays Pokémon Red (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hey HN! Wanted to share a fun project I've been hacking on. Given Jev can make decisions really fast (but not fast enough to play Doom yet sadly), I wanted to try and push it to play a more complex game than Tetris. So I went with Pokémon. I've spent endless hours playing this game as a child so building this was a ton of fun. I open sourced everything in case you want to hack on it yourself here: https://github.com/christianmat/jev-pokemon The game is being streamed live including the tokens and cost - hopefully we get all the badges and don't get stuck in a cave :) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49845172 Points: 230 # Comments: 93
